description:
Click & Grow creates zero-effort smart indoor gardens that bridge the gap between modern life and nature. We provide everyone with a chance to experience the benefits of growing healthy herbs, greens and veggies right at home.

Smart Gardens make it possible to grow plants all year round even in the busiest households. They take care of watering, light and nutrients, while the customers reap the benefits.

AFFILIATE PROGRAM FAQ


Welcome to Click & Grow Affiliate Program! In this document, you can find the answers to the most common questions we receive from our partners.

 

We will cover important topics such as:   

  • Program requirements (commission, test product, affiliate link, etc.);

  • The Uppromote system (how to use it, where to find your link, how to see your commission, etc);

  •  Your Smart Garden maintenance & support. 

 

If you want to suggest any additional information to be added to this file, feel free to let us know via email:  affiliate@clickandgrow.com.

 

NB: To easily navigate inside the document, please use the control/command + f on your keyboard.

 

General Questions

WHAT ARE THE REQUIREMENTS TO BE ACCEPTED TO THE PROGRAM?

The program is a great fit for bloggers, influencers, YouTube creators, freelancers, and small businesses. Your audience can be interested in sustainable living, health, beauty & fitness, using technology to improve everyday tasks, or growing fresh greens all year round.


To be accepted to the program, you need to have at least 10,000 followers/monthly website visitors/subscribers. Click & Grow has the right to not accept an affiliate application if we do not see a match for our program (content, values, category served).

 

HOW MUCH DO I EARN FROM THE AFFILIATE PROGRAM?

We pay 10% commission for each purchase. This means you can earn anything between $10-240 for each sale! Please note that we only work on a commission basis; we do not offer any extra sponsorship fees for the content created by you.  

 

WHERE CAN I SEE MY COMMISSION AND REFERRALS?

You can review your commissions on your affiliate dashboard under dashboard and commission menu items. Log into your affiliate account: https://af.secomapp.com/click-grow/login 

 

Your dashboard also provides referral statistics, commissions, sales, and clicks during a certain time period. Under the commission menu item, you can review commissions earned. Please note that due to privacy reasons the items included in specific orders referred by you cannot be viewed.

HOW CAN I REFER NEW CUSTOMERS TO CLICK & GROW? 

There are two possible ways to do that.  

 

First, you can use your unique referral link. To get that, navigate to your referral dashboard; your referral link (an “Affiliate Link”) is visible right as you log in. You can copy and paste this link to any post or piece of content to start referring straight away. 

 

Second, you are issued a unique discount code. Not only does this code track your referrals, but it also grants your audience a unique discount for their purchases (read more about it in the How Big Is The Discount For My Audience? section). This code is very easy to use: as long as your follower applies the code at checkout, the referral reward will be yours! To get your discount code, navigate to your referral dashboard and the code will be visible right away as an “Affiliate coupon”.

 

Note: Your unqiue discount code adjusts automatically to offer the best possible discount to your customer. During our general sale events, your code will match the genral sale discount. When there is no general sale live, your code will offer a gauranteed affiliate discount (which is usually 10%).

 

HOW ARE MY REFERRALS TRACKED?

We use cookies to track referrals. The cookies last for 45 days, giving folks referred by you plenty of time to make their choice! 

Commission

WHY IS MY COMMISSION SHOWN AS PENDING?

To ensure the referred order is valid, we have implemented a 30-day commission pending period. After 30 days from the moment of order placement, the commission status will either appear in green with a status approved meaning the order was valid, or as a negative balance and in the color red meaning the order was not valid (was refunded, fraudulent, etc).


I CAN’T FIND A COMMISSION I REFERRED. WHERE CAN I SEE IT?

Click & Grow has 4 different shops in 4 different regions. Due to technical reasons, this means we also have five different dashboards. You are onboarded and automatically logged into our main dashboard where you can review commissions earned in the USA. To review commissions from other shops (Canada, Europe, and the United Kingdom), click the current shop dropdown menu in the upper right corner of your affiliate dashboard (picture below), pick the shop you want to view, and review your commissions.

 

These four non-US dashboards are only meant for reviewing commissions. To perform any other actions and access helpful materials, please navigate back to the main shop (click-grow.myshopify.com).



WHEN WILL I RECEIVE MY COMMISSION PAYMENT?

The payouts are made via PayPal on the first Friday of each month. In order to receive payments, please update your payment settings. Currently, our system only accepts PayPal. To add your payment details please go to Settings --> Payment --> Payment method, pick PayPal, enter your PayPal email address, and click save (see the photo below). If your payment details are not specified, we can not process your commission payments. 


 

Benefits

HOW BIG IS THE DISCOUNT FOR MY AUDIENCE?

We have created a 10% discount for your audience to use on the Click & Grow online store. The discount is valid in all our shops around the globe and will automatically apply when a customer purchases a product using your referral link or uses a discount code at the checkout.

 

During general sales events, your code instead provides the same disount as the general offer. This happens automatically and requires no actions from your end - your code is evergreen and can be used at any time. 

 

If you'd like to change the discount code name, please let us know by writing to affiliate@clickandgrow.com.

HOW CAN I GET A FREE TEST PRODUCT?

Currently, we can only offer a free test product to affiliates whose follower base on their blog, website, or social media is at least 10k. If you feel we should make an exception, please contact us and we can discuss your case. The gardens are distributed according to the size, engagement rate, and content of the main promotional channels.

To receive the free test product, respond to our affiliate program welcome email so we could contact you for further details. 

 

CAN I SUGGEST OTHER INFLUENCERS JOIN THE PROGRAM?

You can now recommend other affiliates to join Click & Grow affiliate program. The multi-level marketing feature allows you as an affiliate to recommend people who would be a perfect match for our affiliate program, and earn a one-time 20€ bounty and 5% commission from the sales they bring in. 

 

You can invite people to join by sharing a Network link found on your dashboard. The feature is available for all the affiliates and for all 4 shops and regions. You can learn more about it here: https://bit.ly/3wBUDws

 

Creatives & Updates

CAN I GENERATE CUSTOM AFFILIATE LINKS?

Yes, your affiliate dashboard allows you to generate also custom affiliate links directing to a specific product or page. To generate a custom affiliate link, log into your affiliate dashboard and click either the Get product link or Get link with source button. Then, enter the data needed and hit “generate”. The links will be saved and you can access them from your dashboard at any time.

 

WHERE CAN I FIND THE MARKETING MATERIALS?

Under the Creatives menu item, you will find links to marketing materials and a 1-pager. In the marketing materials folder, you can find logos, product photos, banners, campaign images, and other ready-made materials and guides which will help you promote Click & Grow products to your audience. If there is anything missing, please send us an email.

IS THERE A NEWSLETTER WITH PARTNER UPDATES?

We are sending a monthly newsletter plus import update emails out every month. All the partners who have been accepted to Click & Grow affiliate program will receive these emails automatically. In case you are not receiving our messages, please check your email provider folders (spam, promotions, social). 

 

DO YOU HAVE A GUIDE ON HOW TO BEST PROMOTE CLICK & GROW?

The Posting Guide (mentioned in “Is There A Number Of Posts I Have To Create?”) includes advice about the best time to post, generating ideas for posts, and increasing your revenue. We also offer some example content for your reference.


You can find the Posting Guide here: https://bit.ly/3JMbocX 

 

Requirements & Limitations

IS THERE A NUMBER OF POSTS I HAVE TO CREATE?

If you signed up for the program after the 20th of February 2022 and received a free Smart Garden from us, we require you to create a certain number of posts that feature the product. The good news is, that these posts are an incredible way to kick-start your affiliate earnings with us! The requirements differ per platform, allowing you to pick and choose the format that will work best for you.

 

You can check out further info you can learn more about these requirements in the Posting Guide available via this link: https://bit.ly/3JMbocX

I ORDERED A PRODUCT USING MY OWN AFFILIATE LINK. WHERE CAN I SEE THE COMMISSION?

Sadly we don't pay commission to affiliates using their own affiliate link and our system does not also track such orders. 

Common Garden-Related Questions

I HAVE A PROBLEM WITH MY GARDEN, WHERE CAN I FIND HELP?

If you have any issues with the garden (lamp not working, something missing, etc.) or simply need help setting it up, please contact us at affiliate@clickandgrow.com.

WHAT TO DO IF MY PODS ARE NOT SPROUTING OR HAVE MOLD ON THEM?

If your pods are not sprouting, please contact us at affiliate@clickandgrow.com. We can troubleshoot your plant pods or send you replacements if necessary. 


If your pods have mold on them, don’t worry, it is completely normal. The plant pods offered by Click & Grow intentionally exclude harmful pesticides that would remove the mold but make the products less healthy and natural in the process.

The mold appearing on the plant pods is harmless to you and the plants. If you don’t like how it looks, we offer advice about removing mold in the articles below:

  • How to remove mold;

  • How to prevent overwatering;

  • How to get rid of mold and algae.

If the problem persists, please contact us at affiliate@clickandgrow.com.

WHERE CAN I GET HELP WITH GROWING MY PLANTS?

Click & Grow app allows you to get advice, helpful tips, and notifications on when to trim, pollinate or harvest your plants. The app is available for both iOS and Android:

  • Apple Store https://apple.co/3aqTA80

  • Play Store https://bit.ly/3sEkJKW
